attributes.title: Central Ohio Chapter AACN Critical Care Symposium 2027
attributes.series: Central Ohio Chapter AACN Critical Care Symposium
attributes.venue: OhioHealth David P. Blom Administrative Campus
attributes.summary:
The Central Ohio Chapter of AACN holds its all-day Critical Care Symposium on Friday, January 15, 2027, at the OhioHealth David P. Blom Administrative Campus in Columbus. Check-in and the vendor expo open at 7 a.m., and the first session starts at 8.

The chapter lists 6.5 CE credits, with The Ohio State University as the accrediting body. One ticket covers the full day and the expo: $30 if bought by October 31, 2026, and $40 after that. Session topics and speakers are not published yet.
